# Which lapsed donors are worth a call?

> Donor retention analyzer for small nonprofits. Paste your gift history to see retention by fiscal year, first-time versus repeat donor retention, and which lapsed (LYBUNT, SYBUNT) donors are worth a call, ranked from your own giving. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
